title: Align your Latents: High-Resolution Video Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
grouping: Two halves without containers. Left: one tapering stack of horizontal bands (wide at the top, narrow at the bottom) that alternates grey 'spatial layer' bands marked with a large theta and saturated green 'temporal layer' bands marked with a large phi and a side label l_phi^i. Right: a vertical chain that zooms into the temporal part: a grey spatial layer, a small 'Learned Downsampling' group (grey Resize trapezoid plus small green Conv2D box) fed by a conditioning input c_S from the left, a green Conv3D layer, a grey mixing box, a green temporal attention layer and another grey mixing box. A small rounded inset with two mask icons explains the two values of c_S.
shapes_depth: Flat square-cornered rectangles with thin dark outlines; the left stack is drawn as a trapezoid cut into bands, so the bands narrow with depth like a funnel. Inside each green layer on the right, two lines of monospace text give the tensor rearrangements before and after the layer, e.g. (b t) c h w -> b c t h w. The mixing boxes hold an equation alpha z + (1 - alpha) z'. The input and output tensors are written as math with their shapes (z in R^{B T x C x H x W}). Dashed grey lines run along the right side as skip paths.
proposed_highlight: The new temporal layers are the only saturated colour in the figure (solid green with a dark outline); the pretrained spatial layers are pale grey, and the Greek letters theta (frozen) and phi (new) label each band so the two parameter sets are told apart without a legend.
lesson: Interleave frozen per-frame layers and new temporal layers as alternating bands of one stack (pale grey vs saturated green) and print the tensor reshape such as (b t) c h w -> b c t h w in monospace inside each temporal layer, so the reader sees where time is folded into the batch and where it becomes its own axis.
notes: Venue CVPR from Semantic Scholar title match (2023, arXiv 2304.08818). Model name 'Video LDM' as used in the paper's Fig. 1 caption. Caption: left = inserting temporal layers into a pretrained LDM; right = detail of the temporal layers.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: temporal layers inserted into an image LDM

core.what: one trapezoid stack on the left alternating pale grey spatial layers (theta) with saturated green temporal layers (phi) between an input and output latent, and on the right one spatial/temporal pair unrolled top to bottom

relations.form: the right column expands the stack: spatial layer -> Conv3D temporal layer -> alpha-mix spatial layer -> temporal attention layer -> alpha-mix spatial layer, each temporal box printing its tensor reshape such as (b t) c h w -> b c t h w in monospace
dashed side arrows carry each layer's input z_i past the temporal layer into a grey mix box that combines alpha z_i + (1-alpha) z'_i
a conditioning c_S enters at the top right through a Resize and green Conv2D 'Learned Downsampling' path into z_i, with a small key for the two conditioning cases

channels.colour: green = new temporal layers (phi), pale grey = frozen pretrained spatial layers (theta), with the Greek letters as a second cue; the small Conv2D in the downsampling path is also green, marking it as learned
channels.shape: wide bands are layers; the trapezoid outline shows the stack narrowing; a small trapezoid is the resize
channels.line: solid arrows are the main flow; dashed arrows are skip inputs to the mix and the conditioning bypass
channels.frame: no frames; the overview and the detail are placed side by side without a callout tie

quality.strengths: Frozen vs new parameters are carried by one channel (grey vs green) and doubled by theta/phi; interleaving is visible as alternating bands; reshapes are printed inside the layer that does them, showing where time becomes its own axis; the mix is drawn as its two input arrows.
quality.weaknesses: The detail column is not tied to the stack by tint or callout, so which band it opens is inferred; the alpha-mix formula is typeset into the mix boxes; the dashed bypass lines bend in long L-shapes along the left of the detail column.

insights.structure: Left: a trapezoid stack alternating grey spatial layers (theta) and green temporal layers (phi) between the input and output latent z; right: a vertical zoom of one spatial-temporal pair showing Conv3D and temporal attention layers each followed by an alpha-mixing box.
insights.data: Latents are typeset tensors (z in R^{B T C H W}), reshapes are printed as einops strings in monospace inside the green boxes, and the mixing is the equation alpha z + (1 - alpha) z'.
insights.emphasis: Green fill marks the new trainable temporal layers against grey frozen spatial layers, with large theta/phi glyphs labelling which parameters each layer owns.
insights.flow: Top to bottom in both halves; dashed lines carry the skip to the mixing equation; a small inset with icons explains the conditioning c_S.
insights.avoid: The left stack and right detail are not visually linked by a zoom cue, and the conditioning inset in the upper right is cramped.

arrangement.units: left: one trapezoid layer stack; right: vertical column of layer boxes (detail), unframed
arrangement.inputs_as: typeset latent tensor z and condition c_S
